meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拦住 AI 绕开提交检查的行为,让每次提交都过质量门禁
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果担心 AI 助手用 --no-verify 跳过提交检查,想让质量门禁强制生效。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from bypassing commit checks so every commit passes the gate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry AI assistants skip commit checks with --no-verify and want the gate enforced.

howto.what: Claude 会拦下带跳过标志的 git 提交命令:凡 Bash 调用里出现 --no-verify、--no-gpg-sign 等绕过标志,就直接拒绝执行(退出码 2),其余命令照常运行。
howto.when: 为 Claude Code 项目设置提交质量门槛时使用。装好后每次 Bash 工具调用都会被检查一遍。

say.text: 把它加到 ~/.claude/settings.json,让我所有项目都生效
say.note: 全局生效,覆盖所有项目

howto.what_en: Claude blocks git commands carrying bypass flags: any Bash call containing --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign is rejected with exit code 2, while other commands run normally.
howto.when_en: Use when configuring a Claude Code project that enforces commit quality gates. Once set up, every Bash tool call is inspected.

say_en.note: Blocks bypass flags in this project

say_en.text: Add it to ~/.claude/settings.json so it applies to all my projects
Try git commit --no-verify -m "test" and see if it gets blocked
